From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SIG export, evidence manifest & upload checklist

Neha / Monica,

Saw the attachments — nice work. A few packaging recommendations from ops to avoid back-and-forth during procurement upload:
- Do NOT upload a single zip unless the portal explicitly asks for it. Many portals (OneTrust) index individual files better.
- Produce PDF/A for all PDFs (redwood_SIG_v1.pdf -> redwood_SIG_v1-pdfa.pdf).
- Create an evidence_manifest.csv with these columns: question_id, artifact_name, artifact_type, redaction_status, internal_owner. I reviewed the csv and added a column for redaction status.
- Separate PII-containing screenshots into redacted and original (store originals in our secure drive link only).
- For Whistic: create a public profile export and highlight the SIG completion % in the profile.

I can take ownership of the uploads (OneTrust + Whistic). Plan: convert PDFs this afternoon, perform a quick quality pass, and begin uploads tomorrow morning. Will post the upload links once done.

If Dana insists on a single PDF bundle, I can assemble but will still include the CSV manifest as a separate file.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the manifest. A few items from our security procurement side: 

1) Portal preference: Please upload individual artifacts to our OneTrust portal (no single zip). We need native PDFs where possible (PDF/A preferred).
Upload URL (temporary token): https://onetrust.acmeuploads.example.com/session/ABCD1234 — token expires 2026-05-24 23:59 UTC.

2) Additional artifacts requested:
- Network diagram (we need an architecture diagram showing VPCs, subnets, egress points).
- TLS certificate / encryption cert or a signed statement of encryption-at-rest key management (PEM OK).
- CAIQ mapping spreadsheet if you have one (helps speed review).

3) Naming convention: {ACME-REQID}_{artifact_shortname}_{v#}. Example: ACME-REQ12_network-diagram_v2.pdf

4) Acceptance window: We expect uploads by 2026-05-25 to keep the review on schedule.

If you prefer, you can also populate our Whistic record (we pull metadata from there), but OneTrust upload is required for procurement.

Thanks,
